# EdgeWeb

> EdgeWeb is a web development agency, custom software development agency and AI automation agency based in Delhi, India, working remote-first with businesses across the USA, Europe, Australia and India.

EdgeWeb was founded in 2019 (legal name: EdgeWeb Infotech LLP) and builds custom websites, software, AI automation, digital marketing and growth systems for early-stage teams and established businesses. Typical engagements run 6–16 weeks, delivered in phases so a working system ships early rather than one large release at the end. EdgeWeb is a Delhi NCR web development agency (Delhi, Gurgaon, Noida, Faridabad, Ghaziabad) and also delivers for clients across the United States, United Kingdom, Europe and Australia.

## Services

- [Web Development](https://www.edgeweb.co/services/web-development): Custom website development company — corporate and high-performance websites, web applications, CRM/ERP portals and dashboards.
- [App Development](https://www.edgeweb.co/services/app-development): iOS, Android, cross-platform and React Native apps, from MVP to full product.
- [Custom Software Development](https://www.edgeweb.co/services/custom-software): Custom software development agency work — enterprise applications, SaaS platforms, internal tools, and legacy system modernization.
- [AI & Automation](https://www.edgeweb.co/services/ai-automation): AI automation agency services — AI agents and chatbots, workflow automation, CRM/lead/WhatsApp automation, data pipelines and API integrations.
- [Digital Marketing](https://www.edgeweb.co/services/digital-marketing): SEO, technical SEO, local SEO, performance marketing, content marketing, and conversion rate optimization.
- [Branding & UI/UX](https://www.edgeweb.co/services/branding-ui-ux): Brand strategy, logo and visual identity, UI/UX and product design, design systems.
- [Low-Code / No-Code](https://www.edgeweb.co/services/low-code-no-code): Rapid MVPs, internal tools, workflow systems and automation platforms.
- [Custom Solutions](https://www.edgeweb.co/services/custom-solutions): Custom CRM/ERP, dashboards, booking systems, portals and data platforms.
